Tomato tofu

Serves 2

Ingredients

200 g firm tofu

1 tbsp oil

200 g chopped tomatoes

Salt to taste

Method

Pat 200 g firm tofu dry for 1 minute, then cut into slices.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a frying pan. Fry the tofu for 30 seconds per side until golden.

Add 200 g chopped tomatoes and simmer for 10–15 minutes until thickened.

Remove from the heat and rest as directed in note 1.

Season with salt to taste and serve.

Notes

Note 1: Rest for 2 minutes before serving.
